description: GetFeedDetails: the same Feed shape as one entry from Bing's GetFeeds list, for one specific feed URL on a project's matched site. FREE (no credits), read-only. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

feedUrl.description: Absolute URL of the previously-submitted sitemap/feed.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_bing_feed_details
